featured_reviews.name: Vinamra Dholam
featured_reviews.review_text:
I am sharing my honest experience about ICIT Goregaon branch.
The institute teaches the same basic programming concepts to all students, whether they are school students or college students. There is no proper level-based teaching. It feels like they are more focused on admissions than on providing quality education.
They make promises about placements, but there is no real benefit or proper support regarding placements. Also, batches are frequently shuffled depending on trainer availability, which affects learning continuity.
Before taking admission, I strongly suggest that students carefully research the institute and understand everything clearly. Otherwise, it may become a waste of both time and money.
